oldCostCause.title: 独立CostTracker记录丢失完整模型标识并采用错误估价
oldCostCause.evidenceLevel: 真实公共standalone SDK+冻结bundled metadata；内存ledger正常对照
oldCostCause.limitations: 仅未绑定CostTracker；当前EngineRuntime绑定账本，主流程正确；无实际账单/外部价格/网络验证

oldCauseDisposition: Standalone CostTracker full model identity loss differs from ledger-bound normal summary mapping; original status/runner evidence not promoted to current runtime pass.
counterevidence: model grouping uses JSON.stringify tuple provider/providerKind/model, not delimiter concatenation
missing usage and null cost counters are independent; not-sent producer explicitly stores zero usage and zero estimated cost, preventing spurious unknown cost
summary metadata is constrained by typed Omit, actual store caller supplies only metadata fields, group arrays initialized after metadata
formatUsageCost retains unknown-cost and partial flags; actual bound /cost uses per-model summary and /status/TUI display uses same formatted DTO
An ignored legacy detail arg alone does not prove lost breakdown because current bound formatSummary already includes per-model breakdown.
